During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Bimm/Legends|Bimm]] [[expeditor]] [[Crote (Bimm)|Crote]] operated from a '''[[Planet/Legends|planet]]''' somewhere in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Hunting the Hunters" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of "[[Hunting the Hunters]]" to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref> shortly after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Andov Syn|Nariss Siv Loqesh]] traveled to the world to have Crote hold the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Bie Breil'lya]] captive on his behalf.<ref name="Hunting the Hunters" />
